notes: 中国独轮车的图像证据早于诸葛亮；约公元二世纪初四川一带已有记载。诸葛亮「木牛流马」常被说成独轮车，但也有学者复原为四轮车，故不应把发明权简单归于诸葛亮。欧洲独轮车出现更晚，与中国谱系关系另有讨论。
notes_en: Chinese one-wheeled barrows are imaged by the early 2nd century CE in Sichuan, before Zhuge Liang. His “wooden ox / gliding horse” is often called a wheelbarrow, but some reconstructions make it four-wheeled, so he should not be treated as sole inventor. European wheelbarrows appear later.
summary_zh: 中国独轮车约公元二世纪初已见于四川图像；诸葛亮「木牛流马」是否即独轮车仍有争议，不应简单视为唯一发明人。
summary_en: Chinese wheelbarrows appear in Sichuan imagery by about 118 CE. Whether Zhuge Liang’s “wooden ox” was a wheelbarrow remains disputed; he should not be treated as the sole inventor.
